violations.detail: Plan promises "hypertrophy" but duration is 2wk — that adaptation is not physiologically deliverable in this window.

raw_text:
PLAN "Hotel Room Maintenance Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain hypertrophy gains during 2-week travel period"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m

      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x20..25 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core and Mobility":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 3m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m

      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Pull":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m

      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Circuit":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pull_up 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 2m

      DAY Saturday training 25m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_circles 2x10..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          leg_swings 2x10..12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          inchworm 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          child_pose 3x30..45 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          pigeon_pose 2x30..45 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m

      DAY Sunday rest

    WEEK 2:
